questions.prompt: My brother flies an aeroplane. He is a ___. (A doctor, B tailor, C pilot, D fish man)
steps: A pilot flies an aircraft.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: ___ is the meal taken in the afternoon. (A breakfast, B lunch, C dinner, D brunch)
steps: Lunch is the usual midday or afternoon meal.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is the plural pronoun corresponding to she? (A shes, B shees, C they, D hers)
steps: They refers to more than one person.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The son of your aunt is your ___. (A uncle, B cousin, C nephew, D father)
steps: Your parent's sibling's child is a cousin.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We ___ on the bed. (A cook, B dig, C sit, D sleep)
steps: Sleeping is the usual purpose of a bed, but sitting on a bed is also grammatical and sensible.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: D. Sleep (intended); C. sit is also possible.

questions.prompt: Our English teacher ___ us to study hard every day. (A tell, B tells, C telling, D told)
steps: The singular subject takes tells for a daily habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Last week our team Dreams FC ___ the match. (A win, B won, C wins, D wined)
steps: Last week requires the past tense of win, won.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: When I arrived, she warmly ___ me at her house. (A welcome, B welcome, C welcomed, D welcome)
steps: The past action requires welcomed.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: It was ___ when I slept. (A rain, B shall rains, C raining, D been raining)
steps: Was raining forms the past continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He failed the English examination ___ he did not study hard. (A so, B because, C but, D and)
steps: Because introduces the reason for failure.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Match sea with A meet, B buy, C knew, D see, E write.
steps: Sea and see have the same pronunciation.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Match right with the word of the same sound.
steps: Right and write are homophones.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Match meat with the word of the same sound.
steps: Meat and meet are homophones.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Match new with the word of the same sound.
steps: New and knew are homophones.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Match bye with the word of the same sound.
steps: Bye and buy are homophones.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She is a ___ girl in our school. Arrange odog.
steps: Rearrange o-d-o-g as g-o-o-d.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Mary ___ to Bariadi last year. Arrange newt.
steps: Rearrange the letters to the past tense went.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She ___ an email. Arrange rtowe.
steps: Use every letter once to make wrote.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: John ___ early in the morning every day. (wake up)
steps: A singular third-person subject takes wakes for a present habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He ___ his teeth. (brush)
steps: Add es to brush after he.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Then he ___ into the garden to water plants. (go)
steps: The singular habitual form of go is goes.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: After finishing he ___ back home for breakfast. (come)
steps: He takes comes in the simple present.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is Angel's school called?
steps: The passage names the school.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: How many members are in Angel's family?
steps: Count father, mother, brother, sister and Angel.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is Angel's mother's name?
steps: The passage explicitly names her.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is Angel's young sister called?
steps: The final family sentence names Agnes.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Masanja is Angel's ___.
steps: The passage calls Masanja her father.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
